title: Russian officials studying UFOs

tellings.quote: And there have been other Russian officials that come out and say, "Yeah, we we've got people studying the UFO questions."

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, says that several Russian officials have publicly said they have people studying UFOs. He gives no names or dates. If true, it would mean Russia, like the United States, treats the subject as worth official attention.
